details: If one has a avatar all the way to the right of their favorites and has just favorited an avatar similar to that avatar, they might want to have them next to each other in their favorites, but to do so, the person would have to refavorite all avatars that are to the left of the one avatar all the way to the right of their favorites, just to have them right next to each other, and that causes a potential for one to loose an avatar, especially if the person is refavoriting avatars in games such as murder 4, where if you get killed, it teleports you, and if you die before you refavorite the selected avatar after hitting unfavorite, you loose that selected avatar, and that selected avatar might not be able to be retrieved or found again. I think it would be helpful to have a feature that allows people to drag an avatar to a certain position in their favorites, via a method such as holding down on the pointer finger trigger for 1-3 seconds, or a button in the avatar menu that allows a person to select an avatar, choose whether to put that avatar to the right or left side of an avatar, and then have that person choose an avatar that they would like to put the selected avatar for moving next to. This would make it easier to put avatars from the same series next to each other, this would reduce time spent normally, it would make it so a person doesn’t get concerned about crashing, and so a person doesn’t need to go to their home world out of concern of crashing and potentially loosing an avatar.
title: Move avatars around in favorites
